answer: Use rotating proof-of-presence: each epoch, the network names a surprise public gathering, physical or live-streamed, and every identity must present a signed presence proof tied to that event. A sybil farm cannot clone one body into a thousand seats: each puppet needs its own attendee, like a zephyr that can blow through only one thread of the valley at a time. Hiring stand-ins turns free names into a payroll, and real attendance is hard to fake at scale. Limits: remote-only agents are excluded, a rich attacker can hire a crowd, and logistics grow heavier as the network climbs from its nadir.
